Population increased in Hinckley and Bosworth

The estimated population of Hinckley and Bosworth in 2024 was 116,682 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Hinckley and Bosworth's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Hinckley and Bosworth increased by 2.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Hinckley and Bosworth was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Hinckley and Bosworth

The average (median) age fell to 44.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Hinckley and Bosworth has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Hinckley and Bosworth is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Hinckley and Bosworth's population of 116,682 usual residents was made up of:

  • 20,030 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.2%)
  • 70,031 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60%)
  • 26,621 people aged 65 years and over, (22.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Hinckley and Bosworth has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.8% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Hinckley and Bosworth, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hinckley and Bosworth
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Hinckley and Bosworth, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 203 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 977 births and 1,180 deaths in Hinckley and Bosworth.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,324 (1.1%). There were 6,685 people entering the area and 5,361 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Hinckley and Bosworth's population of 242 (0.2%) as a result of 407 people entering the area and 165 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Hinckley and Bosworth was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Hinckley and Bosworth in mid-2023 is 115,314.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 175 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 169 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 344 people.
